nativeCorrections.reason: Original last intro pose clipped six opaque native pixels at the source edge. Four fresh native low-ready poses replace intro only. Other seven rows reconstruct exactly from the first source.

limits: Local references are generated project art, not official production sheets.
Illustrated poses and VFX are authored adaptations; all1:1/network claims remain false.

The source normalization fits each complete native row, including long weapons or VFX. Any measured body-stature compensation is renderer metadata around baseline244, not a PNG change or claim of official cinematic framing; naturally crouched poses remain crouched.

A few native semi-transparent fringes approach the original edge on defeat rows; no active-source opaque artwork is sliced by adaptive seams, and final cells have ten fully transparent pixels of padding.
